history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration work with the Multi-Partner Trust Fund Office to review its guideline on interest in order to improve the mechanism on monitoring the interest earned by non-United Nations recipient organizations with an aim of collecting the interest, where applicable.
history.administration_response: The Administration has followed up with the Multi-Partner Trust Fund Office to identify mechanisms to monitor the interest earned by non-United Nations recipient organizations. The Multi-Partner Trust Fund Office will reach out to non-United Nations recipient organizations to request information on interest accrued. Through this enquiry, it also seeks to determine whether each organization’s internal interest policy permits it to retain interest.
history.board_assessment: Given that follow-up with non-United Nations recipient organizations in relation to interest generated is in process, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.
